core_obligations: Set up the bookkeeping: discard i = 0, n as trivial, view M as an R[t]-module with t acting as phi, put K_i = Ker(t^i), a_i = length(K_i/t^{n-i}M), b_i = length(K_i/tK_{i+1}) and c_i = length(K_1/t^iK_{i+1}), record the boundary values a_0 = a_n = b_0 = c_0 = 0, observe that c_i is finite for i < n because K_1/t^iK_{i+1} is a quotient of the finite-length module K_1/t^{n-1}M, and record the identity K_i cap t^jM = t^jK_{i+j} (proof lines 417-429).

Extract the two relations from two exact sequences: for 0 < i < n-1 the displayed four-term exact sequence 0 -> K_1/t^{n-i-1}K_{n-i} -> K_{i+1}/t^{n-i-1}M -> K_i/t^{n-i}M -> K_i/tK_{i+1} -> 0 gives, by induction on i, integrality of a_i and b_i for i < n together with c_{n-i-1} - a_{i+1} + a_i - b_i = 0; the second displayed exact sequence 0 -> K_i/tK_{i+1} -> K_{i+1}/tK_{i+2} -> K_1/t^{i+1}K_{i+2} -> K_1/t^iK_{i+1} -> 0 gives b_i - b_{i+1} + c_{i+1} - c_i = 0 (proof lines 430-453).

Conclude the symmetry: from b_0 = c_0 the second relation yields b_i = c_i for i < n, so the first relation becomes the recurrence a_2 = a_1 + b_{n-2} - b_1, a_3 = a_2 + b_{n-3} - b_2 and so on, which telescopes to a_i = a_{n-i}, i.e. the claimed vanishing of all e_R(M, phi^i, phi^{n-i}) (proof lines 454-460).
proof_roadmap: Translate the endomorphism into an R[t]-module structure and define the three families of lengths a_i, b_i, c_i with their boundary values (proof lines 417-429).
Derive the two linear relations between these lengths from the two displayed exact sequences, using the intersection identity K_i cap t^jM = t^jK_{i+j} (proof lines 430-453).
Use b_0 = c_0 to identify b_i with c_i and then telescope the first relation into a_i = a_{n-i}, which is the asserted vanishing (proof lines 454-460).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that for an endomorphism phi of M with phi^n = 0 whose module Ker(phi)/Im(phi^{n-1}) has finite length, every multiplicity e_R(M, phi^i, phi^{n-i}) vanishes for i = 0, ..., n (statement lines 405-413). The proof is a self-contained computation: after encoding phi as multiplication by t on an R[t]-module, three families of lengths a_i, b_i, c_i are introduced and two displayed four-term exact sequences are used to produce the relations c_{n-i-1} - a_{i+1} + a_i - b_i = 0 and b_i - b_{i+1} + c_{i+1} - c_i = 0 (proof lines 430-453). The identity K_i cap t^jM = t^jK_{i+j} is what makes those sequences exact, and the final telescoping a_i = a_{n-i} is what converts the relations into the vanishing. The machinery is concrete but the bookkeeping is genuine, so the claim is H2.
